data.name: RelatedRecordsCount description
data.value: Displays the number of records in the configured related table view.

data.name: Description_SelectTheRelatedTableAndViewToCount
data.value: Select the related table and view whose records should be counted by the component.

data.name: Description_SelectWhichStandardColorToUseForTheCount
data.value: Select the color used for the displayed count.

data.name: Description_EnterAHexColorWhenCustomColorIsSelected
data.value: Required only when Number color is set to Custom. Enter a hex color like #0f6cbd.

data.name: Description_SelectHowTheSubtitleShouldBeBuilt
data.value: Select whether no subtitle is shown, a custom subtitle is shown, the current view name is shown, or the localized entity name together with the current view name is shown.

data.name: Description_EnterCustomSubtitleTextForFreeTextMode
data.value: Required only when Subtitle mode is set to Free text. The value is also used as a fallback if no entity or view label can be resolved.

data.name: Description_ShowBackgroundColor
data.value: When enabled, the component shows its background color. When disabled, the background is transparent.

data.name: Validation_CustomColorHexRequired
data.value: Select a hex color in Custom color hex when Number color is set to Custom.

data.name: Validation_CustomColorHexInvalid
data.value: Custom color hex must be a valid hex value like #0f6cbd or #06c.

data.name: Validation_SubtitleTextRequired
data.value: Enter a Subtitle text when Subtitle mode is set to Free text.

data.name: Validation_GenericConfigurationMessage
data.value: Check the component configuration. One or more optional settings could not be read, so safe defaults are being used.
